description: UAT-03 synthetic identity / duplicate scenarios. Each case starts from tests/fixtures/topia_sample.xlsx (synthetic: employees 10001 / 10002, Assignment IDs 90001 / 90002 on source rows 5 / 6) and copies a source row to a new row, then sets cells by normalised Topia row-4 label. All names and numbers are invented; no real data.

missing_assignment_id.description: AC-1: third employee whose Assignment ID is blank

placeholder_assignment_id.description: AC-1 variant: Assignment ID holds a blank placeholder token

conflicting_identifier.description: AC-2: Assignment ID of row 6 reused on a row with different data

conflicting_identifier_other_employee.description: Assignment ID of row 5 reused by a different employee

multiple_assignments.description: AC-3: employee 10001 with three historical assignments; one identifier with leading zeros, one numeric

missing_employee_number.description: Row with an Assignment ID but no Employee Number

dependents.description: Four synthetic dependents on source row 5, appended as ASSIGNMENT_DEPENDENT columns (layout of the Topia 'Dependent Import' sheet), to compare the generated rows with Jake's ' Mny dependents Ex' structure
